description_en: Lists excess end-user device registration applications in the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下用户终端设备的超额注册申请列表
name: ListExcessiveDeviceRegistrationApplications

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 10,000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries on each page. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值范围：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The username. The value must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), asterisks (*), at signs (@), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 用户名。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）、星号（*）、at（@）和空格
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en:
The user ID. You can get the user ID from the `SaseUserId` parameter returned by the following operations:

[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user's device.

[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Queries a list of devices for a user
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID。取值来源：
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~)：查询用户终端设备详情。
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备
parameters.name: sase_user_id

parameters.help_en: The user's department. The value must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 用户所属部门。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、半角逗号（,）、半角分号（;）、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、分隔号（/）、at（@）和空格
parameters.name: department

parameters.help_en: The hostname of the device. The value must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces. If you specify only an underscore (), the query is extended to include devices whose hostnames contain 4-byte UTF-8 characters
parameters.help_zh: 终端设备名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、半角逗号（,）、半角分号（;）、短划线（-）、下划线（\）、分隔号（/）、at（@）和空格。单独输入下划线（\）将额外查询所有名称中带4字节utf-8字符的终端设备
parameters.name: hostname

parameters.help_en: The MAC address of the device
parameters.name: mac

parameters.help_en:
The device ID. You can get the device ID from the `DeviceTag` parameter returned by the following operations:

[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user's device.

[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Queries a list of devices for a user
parameters.help_zh:
终端设备ID。取值：
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~)：查询用户终端设备详情。
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备
parameters.name: device_tag

parameters.help_en: The statuses of excessive device registration applications
parameters.help_zh: 超额注册申请状态集合
parameters.name: statuses

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the excessive device registration applications
parameters.name: application_ids

Applications.description_en: A list of excessive device registration applications

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the excessive device registration application
CreateTime.description_zh: 超额注册申请创建时间

Description.description_en: The reason for the excessive device registration application
Description.example: 这是一条超额注册申请

DeviceType.description_en:
The operating system of the device. Valid values:

Windows: The Windows operating system.

macOS: The macOS operating system.

Linux: The Linux operating system.

Android: The Android operating system.

iOS: The iOS operating system.

Windows_Wuying: Wuying Workspace
DeviceType.description_zh:
终端设备操作系统类型。取值：
Windows：Windows系统。
macOS：macOS系统。
Linux：Linux系统。
Android：Android系统。
iOS：iOS系统。
Windows_Wuying：无影云桌面系统

FullDepartment.description_en: A list of full department paths

IsUsed.description_en:
Specifies whether the excessive device registration application has been used. Valid values:

true: The application has been used.

false: The application has not been used
IsUsed.description_zh:
超额注册申请是否被使用。取值：
true：被使用。
false：尚未使用

Mac.description_en: The MAC address of the device

Status.description_en:
The status of the excessive device registration application. Valid values:

Pending

Approved

Rejected
Status.description_zh:
超额注册申请状态。取值：
Pending：待处理。
Approved：通过。
Rejected：拒绝

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of excessive device registration applications
